# Soil data download {#sec-soildatadownload}

The **standardized** soil data used in this manual can be downloaded from the following link.

[sharable_standardized_v20250723.csv.gz](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rBsdJWp5cZKw7B2xujpqbXjBSmiS83cW/view?usp=drive_link)

Only the datasets that are allowed to be shared are included here. 

LUCAS points have been anonymized by randomly shifting their coordinates within a 1000-meter radius.

These are the datasets included in the standardized harmonized dataset used in this manual:

-   BHR-P
-   BIS
-   GLanCE
-   Geocradle
-   INFOSOLO
-   LUCAS
-   LimeSoDa
-   MarSOC
-   SoDaH

Please ensure to comply with the data usage policies and citation requirements of each dataset when using them for research or other purposes.

For more information about the datasets, please refer to the [harmonization sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1J652XU_VWmbm1uLmeywlF6kfe7fUD5aJrfAIK97th1E/edit?usp=sharing)
